messages.text: Hi, I sent back the bath mat I bought last month. Can I get a refund?

tool_calls.name: propose_refund
tool_calls.arguments: {"order_id":"h11-o1","unit_ids":["h11-o1-u1"],"summary_for_staff":"Customer requests a refund for the returned cotton bath mat."}

messages.name: propose_refund
messages.content: {"ok": true, "proposal_id": "prop-ee791ac4e3f64e63", "status": "ineligible", "outcome": "refused", "amount_minor": null, "currency": "BRL", "policy_citations": ["refund-policy/v1/window"], "next_step": "Tell the customer it cannot be refunded and why, citing the sections given."}

messages.text: I’m sorry, but I can’t refund the bath mat because the request is outside the 30-day window from its recorded delivery date (refund-policy/v1/window).
It’s only a few hours past the window. I understand.

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"What happens if a refund request is only a few hours past the 30-day window? Any exception or review?"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/exceptions", "title": "Exceptions and talking to a person", "text": "Anything this policy does not cover, and any request for an exception, goes to a staff member. The customer can ask for a person at any time."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text: Since you’re asking for an exception to the 30-day limit, a staff member will take over and review it (refund-policy/v1/exceptions).
